title: Who the surfaces are speaking as
description: One record for the name, the positioning sentence and the ways to reach him. Read by site/src/site.config.mjs, by the letter renderer and by the resume, so the three cannot drift. Empty strings are rendered as absent rather than as blanks.

hero.description: The positioning thesis. One sentence that says what he is, not what he does.

title.description: How a resume or a letterhead names the role, which is not the same sentence as the hero.
